title: Ocarina of Time
subtitle: Switch 2 remake checklist
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made checklist. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo. The Legend of Zelda and Ocarina of Time are trademarks of Nintendo.
news: New: a 100% checklist for the Switch 2 remake. Dungeons, songs, stones and medallions, hearts, Gold Skulltula rewards, items, gear and all five bottles.

categories.name: Dungeons
categories.note: Clear every dungeon, from the Great Deku Tree to the final castle.

categories.note: 100 tokens in all. Turn them in at the House of Skulltula in Kakariko for each reward.

items.detail: Reward: the Adult's Wallet.

items.name: 20 tokens
items.detail: Reward: the Echo Gem, new in the remake. It helps you find nearby Gold Skulltulas.

items.name: 30 tokens
items.detail: Reward: the Giant's Wallet.
